description: This file contains classes for cryptographic operations (MD5Crypt and SHA1Crypt) including methods for key-based encryption, decryption, and password generation. It appears to be part of a session management system for the ADOdb database abstraction layer.

classes.name: MD5Crypt
classes.description: Provides methods for MD5-based encryption, decryption, and random password generation.

classes.name: SHA1Crypt
classes.description: Provides methods for SHA1-based encryption, decryption, and random password generation.

methods.name: keyED
methods.description: Encrypts or decrypts text using a key with MD5 or SHA1, depending on the class.

methods.name: Encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts given text with a provided key, returning a base64-encoded string.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a base64-encoded string that was encrypted with the Encrypt method.
